title: MPMMine: Better Benchmarks for Constraint Acquisition
abstract: arXiv:2605.26279v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Constraint Acquisition (CA) and related research on the validation and enhancement of Mathematical Programming (MP) models using domain knowledge artifacts are currently limited by inadequate benchmarks. The existing benchmarks are loosely organized, provide inconsistent types and formats of artifacts for individual problems, are designed for benchmarking solvers rather than CA algorithms, include narrow classes of problems, or omit crucial details for the reproducibility of experiments and fair comparison of CA methods.   We develop a benchmark dataset, a supporting software package, and a benchmarking tool crafted for the consistent, systematic, and comprehensive assessment of CA algorithms, bridging the gap in algorithmic development and experimental infrastructure. translated_title: MPMMine：更好的约束获取基准测试
translated_abstract: 约束获取以及利用领域知识工件对数学规划模型进行验证和增强的相关研究，目前受到基准测试不足的制约。现有的基准测试组织松散，为单个问题提供的工件类型和格式不一致，是为求解器而非约束获取算法的基准测试而设计的，仅涵盖狭窄的问题类别，或遗漏了实验可重复性和约束获取方法公平比较所需的关键细节。我们开发了一个基准数据集、一个配套软件包和一个基准测试工具，专为对约束获取算法进行一致、系统和全面的评估而打造，填补了算法开发与实验基础设施之间的空白。本工作提出了MPMMine，这是一个旨在评估利用多样化工件来发现、验证和增强数学规划模型算法的基准测试套件。
tldr: 本文提出了MPMMine基准测试套件，包含基准数据集、配套软件包和基准测试工具，用于对利用多样化领域知识工件来发现、验证和增强数学规划模型的约束获取算法进行一致、系统和全面的评估，填补了该领域基准测试基础设施的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper presents MPMMine, a benchmark suite comprising a benchmark dataset, a supporting software package, and a benchmarking tool, designed for the consistent, systematic, and comprehensive assessment of Constraint Acquisition algorithms that discover, validate, and enhance Mathematical Programming models using diverse domain knowledge artifacts.
